sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.employeeNumber), T1.email FROM employees AS T1 INNER JOIN offices AS T2 ON T1.officeCode = T2.officeCode WHERE T1.jobTitle LIKE '%Sales Manager%' AND T2.city = 'Sydney'
SELECT COUNT(customerNumber) FROM customers WHERE creditLimit < 220000 AND country = 'Australia'
SELECT customerNumber FROM payments ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.email, T1.employeeNumber FROM employees AS T1 INNER JOIN offices AS T2 ON T1.officeCode = T2.officeCode WHERE T2.country = 'USA' AND T2.state = 'CA'
SELECT MAX(quantityOrdered * priceEach) - AVG(priceEach) FROM orderdetails WHERE productCode IN (SELECT productCode FROM products WHERE productLine = 'Planes')

SELECT T2.firstName, T2.lastName, T3.firstName, T3.lastName FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN employees AS T2 ON T1.salesRepEmployeeNumber = T2.employeeNumber INNER JOIN employees AS T3 ON T2.reportsTo = T3.employeeNumber WHERE T1.customerNumber = (SELECT customerNumber FROM payments ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT T5.productName, T4.quantityOrdered * T4.priceEach FROM employees AS T1 INNER JOIN offices AS T2 ON T1.officeCode = T2.officeCode INNER JOIN customers AS C ON C.salesRepEmployeeNumber = T1.employeeNumber INNER JOIN orders AS T3 ON T3.customerNumber = C.customerNumber INNER JOIN orderdetails AS T4 ON T4.orderNumber = T3.orderNumber INNER JOIN products AS T5 ON T5.productCode = T4.productCode WHERE T2.city = 'Boston' AND T1.jobTitle = 'Sales Rep' ORDER BY T4.quantityOrdered * T4.priceEach DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM((T1.priceEach - T4.buyPrice) * T1.quantityOrdered) FROM orderdetails AS T1 INNER JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.orderNumber = T2.orderNumber INNER JOIN customers AS T3 ON T2.customerNumber = T3.customerNumber INNER JOIN products AS T4 ON T1.productCode = T4.productCode WHERE T3.country = 'USA' AND T2.orderDate BETWEEN '2003-01-06' AND '2005-05-09'
SELECT phone FROM customers WHERE contactLastName LIKE 'M%' AND country != 'Germany'
